Cut mahogany trees
Main Skill: Woodcutting
Max Efficiency: 350%

The mahogany trees stand tall and wide, creating large areas of shade beneath their branches. Their bark is tough to break through even with a superior woodcutting tool, but their intimidating size means nothing over the course of time with enough effort.

The Cut mahogany trees activity is a Woodcutting activity.

Location

This activity can be done at the following location:

  • Blackwater Lake in Empire of Wallisia

Visibility

This activity is always visible.

Requirements

Skill Level Requirements:

  • At least Woodcutting lvl. 70.

Other Requirements:

  • Have Hatchet equipped that requires at least Woodcutting level [60].
